name: Material memory under shared feedback in articulated robot manipulation
claim: A deployable residual material-state estimate may improve constraint-respecting robot task completion beyond fitted classical observers and ordinary shared feedback; this is a falsifiable research question, not an established novel method.
unit_of_analysis: An independently generated material-geometry-task-history block. Keep all pair members, time windows, action branches, sensor replicates, and algorithm replays together; cluster further when material realizations are reused.
primary_population: Naturally sampled histories, equally weighted across two tasks and four test strata. Matched-history pairs form a separate mechanism population.

datasets.name: physical_validation
datasets.requirement: Independent material calibration before calibrated-simulation claims; physical robot tasks only after qualified 3D robot evaluation.

splits.name: training_validation_pilot
splits.held_out: Disjoint material-instance and history-generation groups; no derived-window split
splits.leakage_check: Hash parent block IDs before feature extraction; fit normalization and constitutive parameters on training/calibration only.

splits.name: test_id
splits.held_out: Unseen material/geometry realizations and history seeds within training bounds
splits.leakage_check: No physical realization, paired member, action branch, or sensor replicate crosses splits.

splits.name: test_history_ood
splits.leakage_check: Record actual numerical bounds before test generation; current-observation matching cannot inspect future effects.

splits.name: test_parameter_ood
splits.held_out: Preregistered material-parameter bands outside training support
splits.leakage_check: Do not call an interior withheld band extrapolation; use validation for model choice.

splits.name: test_controller_ood
splits.held_out: Future controller gains and speed combinations
splits.leakage_check: Encode only past observations; issue future commands without future measured trajectories.

splits.name: secondary_structure_geometry
splits.held_out: Qualified additional relaxation modes, constitutive family, mesh/integration setting, or geometry
splits.leakage_check: Report each structural shift separately; do not change it after observing comparative performance.

baselines.name: B0_reactive
baselines.controlled_variables: Same sensors, physical limits, and validation tuning access; report action-interface differences.

baselines.name: B1_classical_observer
baselines.controlled_variables: Fitted correct-family constitutive law, full causal history, same calibration data and planner; local-window variant is additional.

baselines.name: B2_command_lstm
baselines.controlled_variables: Same boundary data, future commands, training budget, feedback, and planner; no future measured indentation.

baselines.name: B3_history_operator
baselines.controlled_variables: Boundary observations and command interface matched; preserve finite temporal history; label adaptation.

baselines.name: B4_latent_physics_graph
baselines.controlled_variables: Same sensors and planner, history-based estimation and frozen rollout latent, equal adaptation data.

baselines.name: B5_property_graph
baselines.controlled_variables: Retain temporal inputs, equal property-fitting interactions, same sensor and compute budget.

baselines.name: B6_constitutive_potentials
baselines.controlled_variables: Boundary observer with equal deployable information; microscopic labels require a separate privileged track.

baselines.name: O_oracle
baselines.controlled_variables: True material state and parameters only for oracle; same constraints, actuation, planner library, and control timing.

candidate.name: C_evolving_material_state
candidate.restriction: No algorithmic novelty claim until a deficiency beyond strong existing baselines is demonstrated.

metrics.name: natural_history_constraint_respecting_completion
metrics.rationale: Measures actual operation utility with full episode constraints, rather than prediction alone.

metrics.name: matched_history_paired_effect_nrmse
metrics.rationale: Tests whether history predicts response differences under common future commands; report effect magnitudes and absolute errors too.

metrics.name: constraint_violation_probability_and_excess
metrics.rationale: Counts force, deformation, joint, and collision violations from episode start, including probes and release.

metrics.name: force_surface_motion_rollout_error
metrics.rationale: Distinguishes constitutive prediction quality from downstream control benefit.

metrics.name: fixed_library_action_regret
metrics.rationale: Compares decisions with an offline privileged oracle using independent physical branch replay.

metrics.name: fallback_defer_and_completion_cost
metrics.rationale: Prevents apparent safety gains by refusing all work and apparent speed gains by discarding failures.

metrics.name: uncertainty_coverage_and_width
metrics.rationale: Empirical scope for reuse or defer decisions, without claiming universal certification.

metrics.name: latency_deadlines_and_throughput
metrics.rationale: Planning computation advances the causal clock; no free paused-time inference.

ablations: Snapshot versus history with matched capacity, fixed evolution law, and common planner
Latent dimensions 2, 4, 8, and 16 with parameter-matched controls
Fixed versus learned evolution under a common encoder
Ordered versus shuffled history and history-conditioned fast feedback
Erase initialization after controlled intervals of shared feedback
Elastic control and zero added latency
Added latency 20, 50, and 100 ms as sensitivity analysis
No uncertainty or fallback, with equal observations and action budget
Equal-extra-compute control and separately reported privileged-supervision track
falsification_criteria: Complete current-observation matching eliminates the measurable future history effect.
A fitted classical or short-history observer explains the effect without a useful learned-method advantage.
Shared credible feedback removes useful action benefit, as occurred in archived E3.
Gain exists only in curated pairs and does not transfer to natural-history operations.
Gain requires artificial delays, weaker baseline information, privileged future motion, or unmatched compute.
Numerical error or contact/coupling artifacts are comparable to the method effect.
The claimed effect fails prespecified model-family or physical-calibration validation.

statistics.primary_contrast: Candidate against strongest deployable baseline selected on validation before test unblinding
statistics.interval: 95% paired hierarchical/crossed bootstrap over independent blocks/material realizations and training seeds; preserve task/stratum weights and add conservative exact paired-binary bounds for degenerate binary outcomes
statistics.multiplicity: One prespecified primary contrast; Holm correction for declared secondary comparison families
statistics.freeze_requirement: Pilot-based clustered power and final sample size must be frozen before final test access; nonsignificance is not equivalence.

compute_budget.requirement: Measure speed and memory on the qualified backend; revise prospectively if full study is infeasible.

artifacts: Source PDF manifest, inspected-page ledger, and novelty decision
Versioned frozen protocol and split/asset/material hashes
Dependency lock or container digest, solver commits, hardware and driver record
Raw observations, commands, realized motion, and acquisition/delivery timestamps
Full state snapshots for deterministic or tolerance-bounded replay
Per-block and per-seed outcomes, including every failure
Aggregation scripts, confidence intervals, and power assumptions
Uncut representative robot task videos and a small reproducible scene
Explicit gate decision before physical robot work
unresolved_before_confirmatory_run: Compatible solver/plugin versions and qualified two-way coupling
Physical or explicitly synthetic material coefficients
Exact force/strain limits, action values, and validity range
Measured sensor noise and latency, match tolerances, and processing budget
Numerical split bounds and prospective final sample size
Faithful baseline code availability and adaptation verification
